page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with exactly 4.0 GB of memory allocated per core.

This instance does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all persistent storage requirements must be met using external network-attached block storage. For connectivity, the virtual machine provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating steady data transfer rates for network-dependent applications.

The resource profile of this server offers balanced compute and memory density, making it qualitatively cost-effective for standard enterprise workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or local NVMe drives. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance, making the instance suitable for web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, and general-purpose production environments.
